name: Halfling Troublemaker

items.name: Graffiti Egg
items.text: The halfling troublemaker throws an egg filled with paint, glitter, and confetti at a creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed a DC 17 Reflex save saving throw or become Dazzled for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

items.name: Keen Eyes
items.text:
The halfling gains a +2 circumstance bonus when using the Seek action to find Hidden or Undetected creatures within 30 feet of it.

Whenever the halfling targets a creature that is Concealed or hidden from them, reduce the DC of the flat check to DC 3 Flat check for a concealed target or DC 9 Flat check for a hidden one.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.text: The troublemaker deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

text:
A halfling's bravado can sometimes lead them into trouble. These tricksters often roam in groups trying to one-up each other's last prank. While troublemakers rarely intend to kill, occasionally their pranks get out of hand.

---

Despite their small stature, a halfling can prove to be a mighty foe if you find yourself on the wrong side of their frying pan.
